## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Tech (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%)) and Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%)) are the only clear sector leaders while most sectors are negative; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -15.29%) ↓ falling shows fear easing but signals are mixed.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear easing (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -15.29%)) ↓ falling and modest equity strength (SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.68%)) are offset by very weak breadth (2/11), while credit is broadly neutral with HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +0.90%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.03% | 1M: +0.40%) → flat.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral: TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +0.73%) and HYG/LQD → flat imply financial conditions neither tightening nor easing materially.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech and Energy leading: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%); the rest of sectors are lagging so Style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US modestly outperforming: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.68%) while EM EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.38% | 1M: +4.57%) shows strength and China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -0.51% | 1M: -3.10%) remains weak.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation intact in parts: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +20.12%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +25.34%) show risk-on flows, while small caps IWM CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.94%) are under pressure.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Bifurcated: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +1.11%) is muted while gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +9.93%) and silver SLV CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +14.84%) show short-term profit-taking.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy showing relative strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%) and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +4.77%) ↑ rising.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Major risk indices and Tech are ABOVE TREND (SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +2.68%); QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.18%)). DIVERGENCE: Breadth is weak (2/11) despite index strength and VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -15.29%) ↓ falling — mixed signals warrant caution.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%) while reducing exposure to defensives such as XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.29% | 1M: -4.78%); monitor breadth and VXX for regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%). BEARISH: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.29% | 1M: -4.78%), XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -3.38%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +4.77%), WEAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.14% | 1M: +16.80%). BEARISH: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.28% | 1M: +9.93%), SLV CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +14.84%).

13. Key Levels?  
Watch VXX ~20 (complacency), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive.  
Tech (XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +6.36%)) and Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.35% | 1M: +7.41%)) showing relative strength.  
Key risk is the low breadth vs index strength and falling VXX (VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -15.29%)) ↓ falling — monitor breadth for a decisive regime move.
